Released on 07/21/26

## Description

**Intelligent orchestration at enterprise scale**

Summer 2026 introduces powerful innovations that help organizations build more intelligent, connected, and scalable business experiences. From advanced AI capabilities and event-driven integrations to enhanced app design, deployment automation, and operational insights, this release empowers teams to automate with greater confidence, accelerate innovation, and deliver more adaptive digital experiences across the enterprise.

#### New features, improvements, and fixes

The following list consists of features, improvements and fixes that are relevant in this update.

#### New features

##### Bizagi Automation

###### **Kafka Event Streaming**

Bizagi now supports [integration with Apache Kafka](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?bizagi-kafka-integration.htm), enabling real-time event-driven communication with external systems. Bizagi can both [consume events from Kafka topics](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?bizagi-kafka-consumer.htm) to trigger actions such as starting cases or creating records, and [publish events](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?bizagi-kafka-producer.htm) as part of process execution. This allows Bizagi to participate actively in event driven architectures, acting both as a decision engine and as a source of events.

Kafka consumption is configured natively in Bizagi Studio, while event publication is handled through a connector available in Bizagi Xchange. Configuration is defined in Development and promoted across environments, with Management Console providing operational control in Test and Production.

This capability enables scalable, asynchronous integrations without relying on Scheduler-based executions.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/QNA1e0fElAphuBfMzCTaj2KWBAEXYNcx)

![bizagikafkaintegration01.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/bizagikafkaintegration01.jpg)

###### **User role synchronization**

[User role synchronization](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?scim_user_role_sync.htm) keeps permissions aligned between Microsoft Entra ID and Bizagi. By synchronizing role assignments from Azure, Bizagi ensures that users access the Work Portal with the correct roles, reducing manual role management.

This synchronization works through the existing SCIM integration, reflecting role changes made in Microsoft Entra ID during user provisioning.

##### Bizagi Artificial Intelligence

###### **Smarter insights with Ask Ada Charts**

[Ask Ada Charts](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?app_designer_ask_ada_charts.htm) enable end users to access contextual reports instantly and act on insights. Ask Ada Charts transforms natural language questions into dynamic visualizations, making business information easier to understand and act upon.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/QBRxZ_A_aSuF2D3UHOz0fBknBkDbMO8F)

![askadacharts.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/askadacharts.png)

###### **Support for AI Agents in Entity Actions**

[Entity Actions](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?studio_contextactions.htm) allow [Master](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?expert_master.htm) and [Persona](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?expert_persona.htm) entities to execute an existing AI Agent using defined input and output mappings. You can add and manage these actions from the available Entity Actions options in the Expert view, Personas wizard, or [Experience Matrix](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?experience_matrix_business_objects.htm).

![aiagentsinentityactions.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/aiagentsinentityactions.jpg)

###### **AI Advisor – Available November for Platinum, Gold and Silver Support customers**

[AI Advisor](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?Monitoring_Recommendations.htm) is available through Monitoring Center to help process owners identify where AI can create the most value. It analyzes production process execution and application metadata to identify tasks with the greatest potential for AI-driven improvement, providing a data-supported starting point for reducing effort, improving processes, and accelerating intelligent automation.

Note: Monitoring Center is available for Platinum, Gold and Silver support customers.

![aiadvisor01.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/aiadvisor01.png)

##### Bizagi Studio

###### **Full rebranding for Bizagi Studio**

This update refreshes the visual design of Bizagi Studio and the Build page to align with the corporate branding introduced in Fall 2025. The enhancement modernizes the user experience by updating colors, icons, and interface to reflect Bizagi visual identity.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/1teQHJpcCEQqek6wUZlS3tA1hWLGjZWt)

![rebrandingstudio.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/rebrandingstudio.jpg)

###### **Client Credentials Authentication for UiPath Configuration**

Bizagi enables the [configuration of UiPath connections](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?uipath-configuring-a-connection-with-orch.htm) in on‑premise environments through Client Credentials, in addition to Classic Authentication. Bizagi Studio now allows users to configure Auth URL, Organization ID, Tenant Name, Client ID and Client Secret for all environments, replacing the deprecated API Access option in cloud connections. This configuration is available in both Bizagi Studio and [Management Console](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?mcw_rpabots_uipath.htm).

![allowclientcredentialsonprem.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/allowclientcredentialsonprem.png)

###### **Read only mode enabled at Task level**

The platform enhances flexibility in [work assignment](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?assignation-to-everyone.htm) by allowing the “read‑only” setting within the Take Ownership feature to be configured at the [Task level](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?task-level-read-only.htm) rather than the Process level. Previously, all tasks inherited the same behavior when work was allocated to Everyone. With this update, each task can define its own ownership rules independently, enabling more precise configuration and better alignment with specific task requirements.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/1teQHJpcCEQqek6wUZlS3tA1hWLGjZWt)

![tasklevelreadonly.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/tasklevelreadonly.png)

###### **Remove Unused Objects**

The [Remove Unused Objects](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?studio_remove_unused_objects.htm) feature helps you keep your project organized by identifying objects that have no active references and removing them permanently. You can review unused objects in a dedicated window and select multiple items for removal. Selected objects are removed logically (not physically) from the database and are excluded from deployments as expected. System objects are protected and cannot be removed.

![removeunusedobjects1.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/removeunusedobjects1.jpg)

##### Bizagi Apps

###### **Accordion control**

The [Accordion control](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?app_designer_accordion.htm) helps structure page layouts more efficiently by incorporating collapsible sections that organize related content in a clear and compact format. It enables users to expand and collapse grouped information as needed, improving the navigation experience and optimizing the use of available space within the interface. It supports text, buttons, media, and data components. The control includes configuration for item titles, optional descriptions, layout distribution, and interaction behavior, initial state and item expansion.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/1_ZSeamVI4qS1yh7mlz523Hry1qmdN5P)

![accordioncontrol.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/accordioncontrol.jpg)

###### **Control visibility by device**

Controls can be configured to be visible on _**Desktop**_, _**Tablet**_, or _**Mobile**_, allowing you to design responsive apps that [display only the controls appropriate for each device type](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?app_designer_control_visibility_by_device.htm).

This configuration is available in the _**VISIBILITY**_ tab of each control and takes effect when the app is published.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/uZfkr_klTO1WKdDoJ8bGMv-tkgqOF6A2)

![appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice01.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice01.jpg)

Controls display visual indicators on the page to represent their visibility settings. When you hover over or select a control, icons for _**Desktop**_, _**Tablet**_, and _**Mobile**_ appear. Highlighted icons indicate that the control is visible on that device, while non-highlighted icons indicate that it is hidden.

![appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice05.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice05.jpg)

![appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice06.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/appdesignercontrolvisibilitybydevice06.jpg)

These indicators provide a quick way to verify device-specific visibility settings without opening the configuration panel.

###### **Top Bar Navigation configuration**

Bizagi allows you to configure the menu in [Top Bar Navigation](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?app_designer_menu.htm) to adapt the app layout and improve user experience. In the App Designer editor, you can manage pages and sections from a single place by adding, editing, duplicating, deleting, and reordering items, and use the main title area to list, filter, and access pages during design.

An onboarding window is available in the editor for Top Bar Navigation, explaining how you can change the navigation type and edit menu items.

![topbarnavigation.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/topbarnavigation.jpg)

##### Management Console

###### **Delta Comparison for deployment packages**

[Delta Comparison](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?mc_delta_comparison.htm) for deployment packages introduces a way to review deployment packages before applying them. From the target environment’s, users can compare a package against the existing environment to see what is new, updated, deleted, or unchanged. Changes are presented with contextual filters and detailed side‑by‑side comparisons for updates, highlighting what changed. Results can be exported to Excel for further analysis, helping teams make informed deployment decisions.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/U9KUY6KyjpJvgs9T23-L56a8fHes-VMq)

![delta_detailedmodificationview.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/delta_detailedmodificationview.png)

###### **Automated deployment via REST API**

Bizagi enables [automated deployment](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?deployment_automation.htm) by exposing export and import capabilities through a REST API. The API allows seamless integration with CI/CD pipelines, automated scripts, and orchestration tools. Deployments can be initiated by external tools and automated workflows, with support for exporting from Development environments and importing into Test or Production environments, with all operations executed asynchronously.

###### **WS-Security certificate configuration and management**

The Management Console includes an option to manage the [certificates used for WS‑Security](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ws_security_certificates.htm), allowing you to handle them easily. You can activate, update, and download the certificate corresponding to each environment (Development, Test, and Production).

Certificates are created automatically when your Management Console becomes available and have a validity of 10 years. If you are coming from a previous version, the existing certificate is migrated automatically during the upgrade, without requiring any action from you.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/GyPnYIRbek9TxG8DJrKZreXj8EcxrEGv)

![ws-security-certificate.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/ws-security-certificate.jpg)

###### **Daylight Savings Support**

[Daylight Saving Time](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?managing_time_zones.htm) (DST) support has been added, allowing configured time zones to adjust automatically. Through the [Management Console](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?user_options_mcw.htm), the system transparently manages time changes, ensuring that dates, times, and scheduled executions remain consistent and aligned with the selected time zone. This feature simplifies time management, ensures accuracy during seasonal transitions, and provides a more reliable experience for users across different geographic contexts. The selected time zone will only affect the display of date and time during your session; it will not impact any internal processes or calculations performed by Bizagi, as all dates and times are converted to the UTC time zone.

[Booster](https://elearning.bizagi.com/my/booster/summer2026/#/lessons/GyPnYIRbek9TxG8DJrKZreXj8EcxrEGv)

![daylight-savings.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/daylight-savings.png)

#### Improvements

##### Bizagi Artificial Intelligence

###### **AI BPU Consumption Report**

Track and analyze AI usage across your company with the [AI BPU Consumption Report](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?consumption-details-ai.htm). Review consumption over time, monitor it against your AI BPU limit and identify consumption patterns or spikes. Use filters such as environment, AI capability, execution level, and execution target to understand where AI BPUs are being consumed and trace it to specific processes, tasks, entities, applications, or AI services. The report also shows the AI models used and the token consumption behind each execution, helping you understand how AI BPUs are consumed. You can export the data to Excel for additional analysis and reporting.

![aibpureport01.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/aibpureport01.png)

###### **Reinforcement Learning configuration for AI Workers**

You can enable or disable Reinforcement Learning for [AI Workers](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai_workers.htm) operating in _**Supervised**_ mode to align with your process requirements, while keeping the configuration synchronized with Management Console. This setting is available in [AI in Process](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai-in-process.htm) within both Bizagi Studio and [Management Console](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai-in-process-mc.htm) (in Test and Production environments only), as well as in the Model Processes step of the Process Wizard in Bizagi Studio, where it can be configured for each task individually.

###### **Export Enterprise Knowledge**

The [Export Enterprise Knowledge](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?automation_advancedd_fromstudio.htm) feature allows exporting Enterprise Knowledge metadata across environments using a deployment package, such as categories, knowledge base catalogs, and artifacts used by the catalogs. Additionally, you can save configurations defined during the export process to reuse them without manually recreating them. This functionality can be accessed from Studio to export the metadata and from the Management Console (MC) to import the and manage the package. Once imported, the metadata becomes available in the MC's [AI Hub](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?mc-enterprise-knowledge.htm) for visualization and management.

![enterpriseknowledgetab.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/enterpriseknowledgetab.png)

###### **Prompt Assistant enhancements**

The following improvements were made to the [Prompt Assistant](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai_agents_from_scratch.htm) in Bizagi Studio:

- **Standardized prompt blueprint**: a unified structure for prompt generation is introduced, clearly defining inputs, actions, and outputs to improve consistency and clarity.
- **Deterministic input inference**: deterministic rules are applied to input detection to identify data types, file requirements, and their effective use in execution.
- **Explicit output contract**: a structured output contract is incorporated with defined types, support for complex structures, and explicit handling of missing data and errors.
- **Knowledge Base Catalogs integration**: only configured knowledge catalogs are used as authorized sources, ensuring accurate results aligned with available content.
- **Connector and AI Action integration**: external connectors and actions are integrated in a controlled manner, including only supported capabilities and reporting failures without simulating successful execution.

These improvements enable the generation of clear, structured, execution-ready prompts with consistent formats, typed inputs, precise output definitions, and well-ordered steps, removing issues such as conversational tone, missing fields, and formatting errors.

###### **Object output variables in AI Agents**

Output variables previously defined as **_Collection_** in [AI Agents](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai_agents_from_scratch.htm) are now represented as [Object](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai_agents_object_output.htm), enabling the configuration of nested attributes that combine simple data types and Object types with up to three levels of depth. Existing Collections are automatically adapted to the new format and continue to behave as before, without requiring configuration changes.

![ai_output_object_elements.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/ai_output_object_elements.png)

###### **Improved handling of prompts**

We replaced the editor used to write AI Agents prompts. The previous editor converted the text into a different format internally, while the new editor keeps the text in plain text. This allows copying and pasting prompts without unexpected formatting changes. Your saved data, workflows, and interaction with the system remain the same.

###### **Reasoning Model support for AI Agents**

Bizagi Studio allows powering AI Agents through the use of reasoning models available in OpenAI, providing greater control over the depth and quality of the generated responses. From the _**AI Hub**_, in the _**Expert**_ view, it is possible to [create new AI Agents](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?ai_agents_from_scratch.htm) or edit existing ones and, in the _**General**_ tab, select the appropriate model for the agent and define its **_Reasoning Level_**. This enhancement makes it easier to configure AI Agents capable of adapting to different scenarios, from quick responses to more in-depth analyses, all from a centralized interface.

![reasoning-models-for-ai-agents.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/reasoning-models-for-ai-agents.png)

It supports color selection, image upload, size and position options, repetition modes, and opacity, all grouped in the **_Design_** tab.

Using Background type, you can select a color or an image as the background, preview the changes directly in the editor, and publish your customization.

The Container style options define how content is displayed over the background, either within a container or across the full screen. The available styles (Clear, Glass, Blurred, and Solid) determine the level of transparency and blur applied to the content area.

This includes _**Case Number**_, _**Creation Date**_, _**Solution Date**_, _**Case Creator**_, and _**Case State**_, which appear alongside your business data when setting up the collection. With this update, you can display these case attributes as columns and also use them to filter and sort the information shown in the collection. This makes it easier for you to review, organize, and understand case related information directly in your app, without opening individual cases.

When you perform a search, the _**Search Cases**_ window displays matching cases or activities, includes customized columns, and allows you to open the corresponding Activity Form by selecting a result. ##### Bizagi Studio

###### **Email Trigger: CC and Sent Date support**

Bizagi supports capturing _**CC**_ recipients and the _**Sent Date**_ in the [Email Trigger](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?email_trigger_configuration.htm), enabling processes to store richer email context without additional configuration; you only need to add the attributes to your data model and map the new Email Trigger outputs, which are automatically populated for every processed email.

![emailtriggerenhancements03.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/emailtriggerenhancements03.jpg)

###### **Using Global Query Options and Second-Level Navigation in the SAP BTP Connector**

**Important**

**To use the SAP BTP integration features introduced in Summer 2026, you must upgrade the Bizagi Dispatcher to version 1.3.x or later. Earlier Dispatcher versions are not compatible with these features. The Dispatcher installation package and configuration instructions are available in the [Configure SAP BTP for SAP on-premises systems](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?configure_sap_btp_onprem.htm) documentation, and the Dispatcher release history can be reviewed in the [Bizagi SAP Cloud Platform Dispatcher release notes](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/en/release-notes/updates/sap-dispatcher).**

- **Query Optimization with Global Query Options in a GET ALL action**


Query optimization with [Global Query Options](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?sap-btp-connector-global-query-options.htm) has been added to allow you to control how data is retrieved from SAP with the goal of reducing data volume and improving integration performance. This capability is available when configuring **_GET ALL_** actions in the SAP BTP Connector wizard and applies from this version onward. You can use it to define record limits, sort results, and select only the required attributes directly in the action configuration.

![sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-01.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-01.jpg)

- **Expanding Navigation Properties in a GET ALL action**


The option to include related information in a single query through _**Navigation Properties**_ expansion is available. This capability helps avoid multiple calls to SAP and simplifies integration design. Configuration is available in **_GET ALL_** actions of the SAP BTP Connector for entities that expose relationships and applies from this version for OData V2 and OData V4 services. You can use it by selecting one or more **_Navigation Properties_** from the corresponding selector, which are automatically added to the action result.

![sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-02.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-02.jpg)

- **Second-level navigation in a CREATE action**


Second-level navigation for _**Navigation Properties**_ is available in **_CREATE_** actions, allowing users to explore the hierarchical structure of related entities before sending data to SAP. This helps understand complex payload structures and reduce mapping errors. The functionality is available when configuring **_CREATE_** actions in the SAP BTP Connector wizard and applies from this version for entities that expose **_Navigation Properties_**. You can use it by navigating through related entities up to two levels, only for visual exploration.

![sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-03.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/sap-btp-connector-global-query-options-03.jpg)

###### **Task Microdeployment**

This feature introduces [Microdeployment for Tasks](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?automation_advancedd_micro.htm), allowing you to export individual Tasks and their runtime configuration without performing a full deployment. Task Microdeployment lets you update execution properties such as _**Name**_, _**Display Name**_, _**Retry Count**_, and _**Asynchronous State**_.

When you import changes, the system automatically validates them, ensuring that only the objects you select are updated. This keeps environments consistent and reduces risks when making minor modifications.

![studiotaskmicrodeployment01.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/studiotaskmicrodeployment01.jpg)

###### **Alphabetically sorted Parameter Entity values**

Bizagi has improved the Entity Values dropdown menu. Now, the dropdown presents them in alphabetical order. This enhancement makes it easier for you to quickly find and select the option you need.

![entityvaluesalphabeticalsorting.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/entityvaluesalphabeticalsorting.jpg)

###### **Daylight Saving Time (DST) Support**

Support for Daylight Saving Time (DST) is added in Bizagi Studio for [Local display time zone](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?time_zone_visualization.htm). The system automatically applies DST when it becomes effective and reverts to the correct UTC time when it ends. This adjustment is strictly visual, as all jobs, scheduled activities, and timestamps continue to be stored in the database in UTC 0, regardless of the local time zone. With this enhancement, you can view all date-time values converted to your local time, including DST adjustments.

![daylightsavings.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/daylightsavings.jpg)

###### **Multi‑select property editing in Forms Designer**

The Forms Designer lets you [edit properties when selecting multiple compatible controls](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?controls_properties.htm) at the same time, showing common properties under the _**Basic**_, _**Format**_, and _**Advanced**_ tabs. This reduces repetitive configuration while preserving individual control behavior. This enhancement applies to supported controls, excluding table columns, hidden controls, and widgets, with changes applied uniformly across the selected controls.

![multiselectproperties.jpg](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/multiselectproperties.jpg)

###### **Notifications for failed custom job execution**

We added an optional [alert notification](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?business_configuration.htm) that triggers when a [Custom Job](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?custom_jobs.htm) encounters an error during Scheduler execution. This supports timely error handling by sending an immediate email and allowing configuration of the recipients, subject, and message content.

###### **Swagger and OpenAPI integration for OData documentation**

Bizagi integrates Swagger and OpenAPI to provide [interactive OData endpoint documentation](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?testing_odata.htm) in Development environments. With credentials generated in the Work Portal, you can review parameters, test requests, and verify responses in Swagger UI or in external API client tools, like Bruno, by downloading a JSON file available in Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0 format that contains all OData endpoints.

###### **Node.js upgrade for connectors**

The Connector Server supports [Node.js 22 as the standard runtime for connectors](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?connector-service-node-upgrade.htm), while maintaining backward compatibility with existing connectors running on Node.js 12. All current connectors will continue to run without changes by default. We strongly encourage customers to gradually migrate legacy connectors to Node.js 22 to benefit from enhanced security, improved performance, and access to modern NPM packages. Migration is optional and can be performed on a per-connector basis, with rollback support available if needed.

![connectorservicenodeupgrade00.png](https://releasenotes.bizagi.com/files/live/sites/docs-bizagi/files/Releases/General%20Availability/Summer%202026/connectorservicenodeupgrade00.png)

###### **Security enhancement for Dynamic Rules Tracer (DRT) OAuth2 authentication**

To strengthen security and improve credential management, Bizagi Studio no longer creates OAuth2 application credentials automatically when [opening the DRT](https://help.bizagi.com/platform/en/index.html?using_the_drt.htm). Users must now manually enter a Client ID and Client Secret generated in Work Portal. Legacy OAuth2 applications created by the previous mechanism are automatically detected and removed when the DRT is opened.
